paragraphs: Shark Robotics designs and manufactures firefighting, security, demining and defense robots, and has done so from La Rochelle, France since 2016. The company states that it engineers, assembles and tests all its systems in-house, from robotics and AI software to battery technology. Assembly takes place in a workshop in La Rochelle, France, covering the entire production chain.

The stated purpose of the robots is to support first responders, defense and security forces in critical operations. The homepage lists a heavy firefighting robot, a medium firefighting robot, a mule robot, an advanced spike strip and a demining robot. A Singapore office has operated since 2019, and the La Rochelle site is described as the R&D hub.

quote.text: Our mission is clear: saving lives through technology by providing reliable robots for the world’s most critical missions.
